items.source:
-- services
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

--modules
local DialogModule = require(ReplicatedStorage.Packages.DialogueModule)
local UIController = require(ReplicatedStorage.UIController)

--references
local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
local MenuGui = playerGui:WaitForChild("MenuGui")
local npc = script.Parent -- Reference to the NPC model
local npcGui = npc:WaitForChild("Head"):WaitForChild("gui")
local prompt = npc:WaitForChild("ProximityPrompt")

local dialogueObject = DialogModule.new("Sell", npc, prompt)
dialogueObject:addDialogue("Got anything to sell?", {"I want to sell my brainrots.", "I want to sell my plants.", "I want to sell this.", "How much is this worth?", "Goodbye."})

--

local dialogueResponse = {}

local Networker = require(ReplicatedStorage.Packages.Networker)
local DataAggregation = require(ReplicatedStorage.Packages.DataAggregation)
local EnemyData = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Modules.Data.Enemies)
local SharedUtils = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Modules.SharedUtils)
local PlantData = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Modules.Data.Plants)
local EffectsHandler = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Modules.EffectsHandler)

local sellNetworker = Networker.client.new("Sell", dialogueResponse)
local dataReplica = DataAggregation.GetReplica()

-- what happens when triggered
prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
	dialogueObject:triggerdialogue(player, 1)
end)

-- logic to go through dialogs
dialogueObject.responded:Connect(function(responseNum, dialogueNum)
	if dialogueNum == 1 then
		if responseNum == 1 then
			local sellAmount = 0
			local backpack = player.Backpack:GetChildren()
			table.insert(backpack, player.Character:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Tool"))
			for _, tool in backpack do
				if tool:HasTag("npcTool") then
					local name = tool:GetAttribute("npc")
					local enemyData = EnemyData[name]
					if enemyData then
						sellAmount += SharedUtils.calculateSellPrice(name, tool:GetAttribute("multiplier"), tool:GetAttribute("mutation"), player)
					end
				end
			end
			
			if sellAmount > 0 then
				sellNetworker:fire("sellAllNPCs")
				dialogueObject:hideGui(`Sure! Here's <font color="rgb(90, 255, 78)">${SharedUtils.ShortenValue(sellAmount)}</font>`)
				EffectsHandler.CashEffect()
			else
				dialogueObject:hideGui("You have no brainrots to sell.")
			end
		elseif responseNum == 2 then
			local sellAmount = 0
			local backpack = player.Backpack:GetChildren()
			table.insert(backpack, player.Character:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Tool"))
			for _, tool in backpack do
				if tool:HasTag("seed") then
					local plantNum = tool:GetAttribute("plantNumber")
					if not plantNum then
						continue
					end
					local name = tool:GetAttribute("plant")
					local plantData = PlantData[name]
					if PlantData then
						sellAmount += SharedUtils.calculateSellPrice(name, tool:GetAttribute("multiplier"), tool:GetAttribute("mutation"), player)
					end
				end
			end

			if sellAmount > 0 then
				sellNetworker:fire("sellAllPlants")
				dialogueObject:hideGui(`Sure! Here's <font color="rgb(90, 255, 78)">${SharedUtils.ShortenValue(sellAmount)}</font>`)
				EffectsHandler.CashEffect()
			else
				dialogueObject:hideGui("You have no plants to sell.")
			end
		elseif responseNum == 3 then
			local equippedTool = player.Character:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Tool")
			if equippedTool then
				local sellPrice = 0
				if equippedTool:HasTag("npcTool") then
					sellPrice = SharedUtils.calculateSellPrice(equippedTool:GetAttribute("npc"), equippedTool:GetAttribute("multiplier"), equippedTool:GetAttribute("mutation"), player)
				elseif equippedTool:HasTag("seed") and equippedTool:GetAttribute("plantNumber") ~= nil then
					sellPrice = SharedUtils.calculateSellPrice(equippedTool:GetAttribute("plant"), equippedTool:GetAttribute("multiplier"), equippedTool:GetAttribute("mutation"), player)
				end
				
				sellNetworker:fire("sellHoldingItem", equippedTool)
				dialogueObject:hideGui(`Sure! Here's <font color="rgb(90, 255, 78)">${SharedUtils.ShortenValue(sellPrice)}</font>.`)
				EffectsHandler.CashEffect()
			else
				dialogueObject:hideGui("You need to equip something first.")
			end
		elseif responseNum == 4 then
			local equippedTool = player.Character:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Tool")
			if equippedTool then
				local sellPrice = 0
				if equippedTool:HasTag("npcTool") then
					sellPrice = SharedUtils.calculateSellPrice(equippedTool:GetAttribute("npc"), equippedTool:GetAttribute("multiplier"), equippedTool:GetAttribute("mutation"), player)
				elseif equippedTool:HasTag("seed") and equippedTool:GetAttribute("plantNumber") ~= nil then
					sellPrice = SharedUtils.calculateSellPrice(equippedTool:GetAttribute("plant"), equippedTool:GetAttribute("multiplier"), equippedTool:GetAttribute("mutation"), player)
				end

				dialogueObject:hideGui(`It's worth <font color="rgb(90, 255, 78)">${SharedUtils.ShortenValue(sellPrice)}</font>.`)
			else
				dialogueObject:hideGui("You need to equip something first.")
			end
		elseif responseNum == 5 then
			dialogueObject:hideGui("")
		end
	end
end)

task.wait(.1)
local animObj = script.Parent:FindFirstChild("Animation")
if not animObj or animObj.AnimationId == "" or animObj.AnimationId == nil then return end
local meow = script.Parent.AnimationController
if meow then
    local success, track = pcall(function()
        return meow:LoadAnimation(animObj)
    end)
    if success and track then
        track:Play()
    end
end

items.name: Guide
items.source:
--[[

Plants VS ____ | guide!

If you are reading this, you've received the version of this template finished on 9/27/2025.










-- ============ 
--   TEMPLATE GUIDE
-- ============ 

----------- READ BEFORE MOVING ON! -----------

Step 1: Theme your game
Step 2: Get all your models ready
Step 3: Read below how to import them properly
Step 4: IF using RunTime mutations, alter them in the ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Modules.ApplyModelModifications
Step 5: Update the platform costs in ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Modules.Data.PlatformCosts
Step 6: Update the lane costs in ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Modules.Data.LaneCosts
Step 7: Add your own Product ID's for each product/gamepass in ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Modules.Data.Products
Step 8: Upload and replace all the animations with your own [See below how]
Step 9: Add custom VFX logic in ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Modules.EffectsHandler
Step 10: Replace each sound in SoundService.SFX.PlantAttacks
Step 11: Update the ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Configuration script to your liking
Step 12: Balance your game properly
-- This fully copied by hamasecurity


















THINGS TO KNOW:
	1. This game was coded by Supdoggy - pls subscribe to my yt :)
	2. There are no remote events/functions because I used a Networking modules
		Pretty much it just creates the events/functions when the server is started
		Helps prevent cheats and prevents replicated storage from having 1000+ remote events/functions


























	
	DO NOT REMOVE
		workspace.Characters
		workspace.VFX
		workspace.Map
			workspace.Map.PlotLocations
			workspace.Map.Plots
		

	-- ============ 
	--   BASES
	-- ============ 
	
	There needs to be a "PlotTemplate" plot in workspace.Map.Plots
		- This is the base plot that will be copied to make new plots
		- The plot must be a model
		- The plot must be placed in workspace.Map.Plots
		- The plot must be named "PlotTemplate"
	
	The plot clean-up consists of a complete recreation of the plot (once again, based on the template plot)
	
	-- ============
	--   For all models
	-- ============
	1. MAKE SURE ALL MODELS ARE RIGGED
	2. NAMES MUST BE THE EXACT SAME IN THEIR DATA MODULES, AS IN THEIR FOLDERS
	
	Pick a Mutation method:
		Runtime ; Gold, Diamond, Rainbow will be applied when playing the game. This is pretty limited and provides a basic mutation
					- Place your models in the root NPCs folder, you can safely ignore the mutation folders with this method
					
		Manual  ; So you have your mutated models ready, in ReplicatedStorage.Assets.NPCs you will see folders with mutation names
					- Place your models in the folders with the respective mutation names		



	-- ============
	--   NPCs
	-- ============
	1. Models
		Rigged models
		Make the pivot between the feet [see FAQ if you don't know how to move the pivot]
		Add an "Folder" named 'Animations'
			Place the "Walk" animation in the folder
			Switch the walk animation with the models walk animation
		Add an "AnimationController"
			Add an "Animator" under the animation controller
		Place in ReplicatedStorage.Assets.Enemies
		
	2. Register them in the system
		a. Open ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Modules.Data.Enemies
		b. Copy and paste existing enemy logic and replace with your own
	
	
	
	
	-- ==============
	--   Plants
	-- ==============
	
	1. Models
		Rigged models
		Make the pivot between the feet [see FAQ if you don't know how to move the pivot]
		Add an "Folder" named 'Animations'
			Place the "Attack" animation in the folder
			Place the "Idle" animation in the folder
			Switch the attack and idle animations with the models attack and idle animations
		Add an "AnimationController"
			Add an "Animator" under the animation controller
	
	2. Register them in the system
		a. Open ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Modules.Data.Plants
		b. Copy and paste existing plant logic and replace with your own
		
	3. Animations
		a. Upload each animation under this script under your group
		b. Replace each animation ID under each plant model with your own
		c. Do this for each attack and idle animation
	
	
	
F.A.Q.
	Adjusting pivots:
		Move rigs to workspace, select with Edit Pivot tool (Model tab),
		place pivot between legs at base.
		
		
	Changing base Plant/NPC size:
		Scale the model to whatever you want the base size to be
		Then in the properties of the model reset the Scale value by clicking that arrow

]]--
